activity_exception_decoration.help: Type of the exception activity on record.

activity_exception_icon.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.

activity_state.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.

auto_post.help: Specify whether this entry is posted automatically on its accounting date, and any similar recurring invoices.

auto_post_until.help: This recurring move will be posted up to and including this date.

bank_partner_id.help: Technical field to get the domain on the bank

campaign_id.help: This is a name that helps you keep track of your different campaign efforts, e.g. Fall_Drive, Christmas_Special

company_price_include.help: Default on whether the sales price used on the product and invoices with this Company includes its taxes.

country_code.help:
The ISO country code in two chars. 
You can use this field for quick search.

direction_sign.help: Multiplicator depending on the document type, to convert a price into a balance

fiscal_position_id.help: Fiscal positions are used to adapt taxes and accounts for particular customers or sales orders/invoices. The default value comes from the customer.

invoice_cash_rounding_id.help: Defines the smallest coinage of the currency that can be used to pay by cash.

invoice_currency_rate.help: Currency rate from company currency to document currency.

invoice_incoterm_id.help: International Commercial Terms are a series of predefined commercial terms used in international transactions.

invoice_origin.help: The document(s) that generated the invoice.

invoice_vendor_bill_id.help: Auto-complete from a previous bill or refund.

is_being_sent.help: Is the move being sent asynchronously

is_move_sent.help: It indicates that the invoice/payment has been sent or the PDF has been generated.

is_self_billing.help: This journal is for self-billing invoices. Invoices will be created using a different sequence per partner.

journal_group_id.help:
By default, all journals post to the Statutory Ledger (Local GAAP). 
Specifying a ledger allows you to isolate IFRS, Tax, or Intercompany adjustments without affecting local statutory accounts.

medium_id.help: This is the method of delivery, e.g. Postcard, Email, or Banner Ad

message_has_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_has_error_counter.help: Number of messages with delivery error

message_has_sms_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_needaction.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.

no_followup.help: Exclude this journal entry from Reminder reports.

partner_bank_id.help: Bank Account Number to which the invoice will be paid. A Company bank account if this is a Customer Invoice or Vendor Credit Note, otherwise a Partner bank account number.

partner_shipping_id.help: The delivery address will be used in the computation of the fiscal position.

payment_reference.help: The payment reference to set on journal items.

purchase_id.help: Auto-complete from a past purchase order.

purchase_vendor_bill_id.help: Auto-complete from a previous bill, refund, or purchase order.

purchase_warning_text.help: Internal warning for the partner or the products as set by the user.

qr_code_method.help: Type of QR-code to be generated for the payment of this invoice, when printing it. If left blank, the first available and usable method will be used.

quick_edit_total_amount.help:
Use this field to encode the total amount of the invoice.
Odoo will automatically create one invoice line with default values to match it.

reconciled_payment_ids.help: Payments that have been reconciled with this invoice.

restrict_mode_hash_table.help: If ticked, when an entry is posted, we retroactively hash all moves in the sequence from the entry back to the last hashed entry. The hash can also be performed on demand by the Secure Entries wizard.

sale_warning_text.help: Internal warning for the partner or the products as set by the user.

secured.help: The entry is secured with an inalterable hash.

source_id.help: This is the source of the link, e.g. Search Engine, another domain, or name of email list

tax_cash_basis_created_move_ids.help: The cash basis entries created from the taxes on this entry, when reconciling its lines.

tax_cash_basis_origin_move_id.help: The journal entry from which this tax cash basis journal entry has been created.

tax_totals.help: Edit Tax amounts if you encounter rounding issues.

account.move.order: date desc, name desc, invoice_date desc, id desc

account_cash_basis_base_account_id.help: Account that will be set on lines created in cash basis journal entry and used to keep track of the tax base amount.

account_enabled_tax_country_ids.help: Technical field containing the countries for which this company is using tax-related features(hence the ones for which l10n modules need to show tax-related fields).

account_fiscal_country_id.help: The country to use the tax reports from for this company

account_opening_date.help: That is the date of the opening entry.

account_opening_journal_id.help: Journal where the opening entry of this company's accounting has been posted.

account_opening_move_id.help: The journal entry containing the initial balance of all this company's accounts.

account_peppol_contact_email.help:
Primary contact email for Peppol connection related communications and notifications.
In particular, this email is used by Odoo to reconnect your Peppol account in case of database change.

account_peppol_phone_number.help: This number is used for identification purposes only.

selection: Can send, pending registration to receive

account_price_include.help: Default on whether the sales price used on the product and invoices with this Company includes its taxes.

account_use_credit_limit.help: Enable the use of credit limit on partners.

annual_inventory_day.help:
Day of the month when the annual inventory should occur. If zero or negative, then the first day of the month will be selected instead.
        If greater than the last day of a month, then the last day of the month will be selected instead.

annual_inventory_month.help: Annual inventory month for products not in a location with a cyclic inventory date. Set to no month if no automatic annual inventory.

automatic_entry_default_journal_id.help: Journal used by default for moving the period of an entry

company_details.help: Header text displayed at the top of all reports.

country_code.help:

days_to_purchase.help: Days needed to confirm a PO, define when a PO should be validated

display_invoice_amount_total_words.string: Total amount of invoice in words

downpayment_account_id.help: This account will be used on Downpayment invoices.

expense_account_id.help: The expense is accounted for when a vendor bill is validated, except in anglo-saxon accounting with perpetual inventory valuation in which case the expense (Cost of Goods Sold account) is recognized at the customer invoice validation.

expense_accrual_account_id.help: Account used to move the period of an expense

fiscalyear_lock_date.help: Any entry up to and including that date will be postponed to a later time, in accordance with its journal's sequence.

hard_lock_date.help: Any entry up to and including that date will be postponed to a later time, in accordance with its journal sequence. This lock date is irreversible and does not allow any exception.

has_vat.help: Technical field indicating whether the Tax ID is not a placeholder.Returns False for placeholder values such as '/', 'NA', 'na', or an empty string.

horizon_days.help:
Configure your horizon to trigger reordering rules earlier to get
                                a head start on replenishment and avoid delays, or trigger it just-in-time
                                ('0 days') to avoid overstocking.

income_account_id.help: This account will be used when validating a customer invoice.

incoterm_id.help: International Commercial Terms are a series of predefined commercial terms used in international transactions.

invoice_terms_html.string: Default Terms and Conditions as a Web page

l10n_au_is_gst_registered.help: Enable if your company is registered for GST.

l10n_au_trading_name.help: The trading name of the company.

multi_vat_foreign_country_ids.help: Countries for which the company has a Tax ID

pay_later_label.help: The label to be displayed on the payment buttons for 'Pay Later' payment methods.

pay_now_label.help: The label to be displayed on the payment buttons for 'Pay Now' payment methods.

po_double_validation.help: Provide a double validation mechanism for purchases
selection: Confirm purchase orders in one step
Get 2 levels of approvals to confirm a purchase order

po_double_validation_amount.help: Minimum amount for which a double validation is required

po_lock.help: Purchase Order Modification used when you want to purchase order editable after confirm
selection: Confirmed purchase orders are not editable

prepayment_percent.help: The percentage of the amount needed to be paid to confirm quotations.

price_difference_account_id.help: During perpetual valuation, this account will hold the price difference between the standard price and the bill price.

purchase_lock_date.help: Any purchase entry prior to and including this date will be postponed to a later date, in accordance with its journal's sequence.

quotation_validity_days.help: Days between quotation proposal and expiration. 0 days means automatic expiration is disabled

report_footer.help: Footer text displayed at the bottom of all reports.

restrictive_audit_trail.help: Enable this option to prevent deletion of journal item related logs

revenue_accrual_account_id.help: Account used to move the period of a revenue

sale_automatic_invoice.help:
The invoice is generated automatically and available in the customer portal when the transaction is confirmed by the payment provider.
The invoice is marked as paid and the payment is registered in the payment journal defined in the configuration of the payment provider.
This mode is advised if you issue the final invoice at the order and not after the delivery.

sale_lock_date.help: Any sales entry prior to and including this date will be postponed to a later date, in accordance with its journal's sequence.

security_lead.help: Margin of error for dates promised to customers. Products will be scheduled for procurement and delivery that many days earlier than the actual promised date, to cope with unexpected delays in the supply chain.

sequence.help: Used to order Companies in the company switcher

show_sol_numbers.help: Display line numbers on Sales Orders.

stock_mail_confirmation_template_id.help: Email sent to the customer once the order is done.

stock_sms_confirmation_template_id.help: SMS sent to the customer once the order is delivered.

tax_lock_date.help: Any entry with taxes up to and including that date will be postponed to a later time, in accordance with its journal's sequence. The tax lock date is automatically set when the tax closing entry is posted.

selection: Add a link to a Web Page

transfer_account_id.help: Intermediary account used when moving money from a liquidity account to another

allow_out_payment.help: Sending fake invoices with a fraudulent account number is a common phishing practice. To protect yourself, always verify new bank account numbers, preferably by calling the vendor, as phishing usually happens when their emails are compromised. Once verified, you can activate the ability to send money.
